colors.description:
- The most primitive digestive system - approximately 1.2 billion people have this
						- Eat one thing at a time: "You want salt? Take a pinch of salt and put it on your tongue. One thing at a time."
						- People with this diet have the most powerful reaction when they start eating correctly
						- This is a very extreme diet that people will initially resist: "you're gonna hate it"
						- Those who persist for 3-5 years often experience dramatic physical changes and eventually "found their thing"

- The gatherer diet - extremely rigid, eating the same thing day after day
						- Should eat as much local produce as possible from the area you're living in
						- Babies with this color show discernment immediately - open babies will try new foods, closed babies won't even let the spoon in
						- These people need to find exactly what's perfect for them and stay with it, with only seasonal changes allowed
						- The speaker's sister has this and "insisted on eating the same things" even before knowing about her design

- Deals with temperature - hot or cold
						- Cold side: can only consume liquids and foods below body temperature because they have an overheated system that burns off what they need
						- Hot side: need everything above body temperature because they have weak digestive systems running cold that need heat for chemical reaction
						- The speaker's youngest son is cold and was born premature, never experiencing the instant conditioning from mother's breast

- About the environment when eating, not about controlling your own digestive process
						- Calm (left side): need to be in a calm environment when eating - the speaker is this type and takes most meals alone
						- Nervous (right side): need energy and disturbance while eating - shouldn't sit through a meal, can "eat while they're walking and, you know, can eat and dance"
						- The speaker's son Loki is nervous - when they eat together, if it's calm it's bad for him, if it's disturbing it's bad for the speaker

- About acoustic environments
						- High (left): need sound around when eating - should use iPod, turn up volume, perfect for busy restaurants
						- Low (right): need silence - should use sound reduction headphones or soundproof rooms
						- Connected to modern technologies for portable noise or noise elimination

- The most sophisticated and sensitive digestive system
						- Direct (left): can only eat when the sun is up
						- Indirect (right): "nocturnals" who can only eat when the sun is down
						- Nearly 800 million people work while others sleep - cities that never close support this
						- The speaker advises indirect people to "change their lives. Sleep in the daytime. Get night shift work"
						- One student from Greece is preparing to "teach human design to nocturnals nocturnally"
						- Liquids are not restricted by time - can be taken throughout the day in any diet
						- Can be challenging in northern countries with limited winter daylight

- Security-focused environments with controlled entry/exit
							- Need one entrance for security (multiple doors can disturb sleep in children)
							- Indoor people who control who enters their space
							- Examples: offices, enclosed spaces, automobiles
						-

- Fundamentally urban, need to be where the action is
							- Internal markets: business at home
							- External markets: out in the urban marketplace
							- Environment is foundation for material success
						-

- Divided into wet (high humidity) and dry (low humidity)
							- Places of transformation and creation
							- Most sophisticated and creative urban environments
							- Where things are designed and built

- Need thin oxygen, thrive at high altitude
							- Designed to be above things, looking down
							- Active vs. passive mountain orientations
							- Not meant to get involved in nitty-gritty details
							- Others must climb the mountain to reach them
						-

- Original highways where everything moved along
							- Internationalists designed to integrate with the world
							- Need to be where there's flow and movement
							- Need lots of oxygen, belong at ground level
							- Narrow valleys (urban) vs. wide valleys (bucolic)
							- Cannot thrive in true isolation
						-

- Connection to water is deeply important
							- Natural shores (water boundaries) or artificial shores (park boundaries, city divisions)
							- About having a horizon to look beyond

- Sees what can survive and what's necessary for survival
						- Can lead to deep materialism and seeing what people are afraid of
						- Sees the most primitive, foundational level of the world
						- Transfers to/from wanting (4th color)

- Sees possibilities in everything and everyone
						- Sweet quality that can be wonderful as outer authority
						- Yearns to see possibility realized due to distraction to probability
						- Inherent hope and belief in this perspective
						- Transfers to/from probability (5th color)

- Sees who's winning and losing, who's up and down
						- Related to the material plane - seeing who wins and loses literally
						- The measuring ones - best restaurant, top rankings, classifications
						- Transfers to/from personal (6th color)

- Sees what's missing and what's needed
						- Deeply social perspective with capacity for connection
						- Can become trapped trying to fix or address the needs seen
						- Transfers to/from survival (1st color)

- Unsure people who see probabilities
						- Can bet everything on probability when not-self
						- Distraction to possibility provides necessary balance
						- Transfers to/from possibility (2nd color)

- Sees everything through own context and process
						- Very narcissistic - frames everything through own dimension
						- Can be deeply isolating with inherent naivety if stuck in own perspective
						- Needs distraction to power (3rd) to see what's going on in world
						- Transfers to/from power (3rd color)

- Motivated by the unknown - foundation of conceptual intelligence
						- Natural learners who dig deep to understand
						- Not about being afraid, but about understanding what you can't yet comprehend

- Knows when not to act, when not to push
						- In transference becomes "dumb hope" - false expectations without cognitive backing

- Overwhelming motivation that powerfully drives organization and leadership
						- The speaker's own motivation
						- In transference becomes avoidance and "innocence" as an escape

- Thinks about what needs to be thought about - not extraneous matters
						- Critical given that 70% of humanity has undefined head centers and think about things that don't matter

- Fixers - motivated to repair and correct things
						- Uses guilt as a tool for universalizing change
						- In transference becomes those who hope things get fixed without knowing how

- Not actually a motivation - designed to be without agenda
						- All transitional profiles (1-4, 2-5, 3-6, 4-1, 5-2, 6-3) have sixth color motivation
						- Serves as innocent bridges in humanity's communication chain
						- In transference becomes controlling and agenda-driven
